name: Peace Symbol
instruction: Can you create a 3D model of a peace symbol? It should be a simple circle with a vertical line and two downward-sloping lines inside it.

Shape accuracy: The object in the model is a peace symbol.
The outer shape is a simple circle.
There is a vertical line extending from the top to the bottom of the circle.
Two downward-sloping lines are present, originating from the vertical line.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The circle is proportionate to the lines inside.
The length of the vertical line is appropriate relative to the circle's diameter.
The downward-sloping lines are evenly spaced and symmetrical.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The vertical line is centered within the circle.
The downward-sloping lines are symmetrically positioned.
The lines do not extend beyond the circle's boundary.
Object distance and contact: The lines are connected to the circle without gaps.
There is no overlap between the lines and the circle.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified attributes of the peace symbol are accurately represented.
The model adheres to the simplicity requested in the instruction.
